question.problem:
Find the vector $x$, if $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ and 

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ -5\end{aligned}],\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
We know that any vector in  $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ has the form

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ -5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are the coordinates relative to the basis $\,B.$ Since we are told that $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5\end{aligned}],$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={{(\,2\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{{(\,5\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ -5\end{aligned}]= \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -4 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 0 \\ -25\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -4 \\ -21\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
